name: gtm
description: Take a GTM Automation workspace from empty to a live outbound campaign, run named motions end to end, and close the loops that keep it running. Ships gtm-quickstart (nine-stage build path incl. the intake interview), plays (nine templates), agents-loops-goals (missions, scoped agents, scheduled sources, signal watches, event triggers, approval gates), outbound-playbook (method, benchmarks and cross-workspace learnings), sequences (touch plans and the template copy doctrine), draft-gtm-play, build-gtm-workflow, gtm-handoffs, gtm-operate and a guided setup skill. Requires a workspace on the Growth plan or higher.

workspace_mcp_key.title: GTM Automation workspace MCP key
workspace_mcp_key.description: Your per-workspace MCP key from the app: Erweiterungen/Extensions -> MCP. Growth plan or higher. Stored in secure storage, never in a plain settings file.
